# Shifali Gwal

> Shifali Gwal is a Bengaluru-based frontend engineer and UI/UX designer who designs interfaces in Figma and builds them in React and Next.js, with a focus on Core Web Vitals, SEO and accessibility. Open to Frontend Engineer, UI/UX Designer and Design Engineer roles, hybrid or remote.

## Work

- JaisPro (Mar – Aug 2026): Freelance UI/UX designer. Designed a company website and an e-commerce website in Figma, grounded in user research.
- D2C web app, wallet and rewards (Apr – Sep 2024): Web developer. Built on Next.js App Router and Tailwind CSS. LCP 0.8 s and CLS 0.03 on 4G. Wallet and rewards engine raised average order value 27% with ₹1.6 crore redeemed. SEO playbook (dynamic OG tags, sitemap, structured data) raised organic traffic 58% in 8 weeks.
- Madras Mandi (Jul 2022 – Apr 2024): Full-stack developer. Migrated React to Next.js with SSR and ISR, cutting page load by 2.4 s and bundle size by 210 kB. Built Instant Delivery with location-aware slots, growing daily orders 1.7× (2,000 to 3,400). Built the OgClub B2B portal, handling ₹4.2 crore monthly GMV.

## Research

- M.Tech dissertation, Shri Venkateshwara University: "Performance Analysis of Supervised Learning Algorithms on Structured Data". Compared 8 algorithms on 4 UCI datasets; XGBoost ranked best, Random Forest second.

## Skills

- Design: Figma, UI design, UX design, user research
- Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Redux-Saga
- Quality: Core Web Vitals, SEO, performance budgets, visual regression tests
- Tooling: Jotai, Vite, Turborepo, GitLab CI, Node.js
